A big feature update. Works alongside 1.0 phones.

- **Channels**: join or create `#topic` rooms from the Chats tab. Anyone who types the same name joins the same channel. Add a **password** and messages are encrypted so only people who know it can read them.
- **Replies**: swipe a message right (or long-press → Reply) to quote it; tap a quote to jump to the original.
- **Reactions**: long-press for 👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 🙏, or double-tap for ❤️. Works in DMs, #nearby and channels.
- **Delete for everyone** on your own messages, and **Delete for me** on any message.
- **@mentions** with suggestions while typing; mentions of you are highlighted and always notify.
- **Formatting**: `*bold*`, `_italic_`, `~strike~` and `` `code` ``.
- **Disappearing messages** per DM (5 min, 1 h, 1 day, 1 week), set for both people.
- **Wave 👋** to nudge someone, and an **SOS alert** in #nearby (hold to send) that gives everyone in range a loud, red alert.
- **Search** inside any chat; **drafts** are kept per chat.
- **Pin** and **mute** chats, **Mark all read**, and message **info** (sent, delivered, read, route).
- **Favorites** (★) with an alert when one comes into range, private **nicknames** for people, and a **People** screen.
- **App lock** with a PIN (also hides the app from screenshots and recent apps), and an option to **hide message text in notifications**.
- **Battery saver** and **message reach** (7 or 3 hops); a **relay counter** shows how many messages your phone carried for others.

**Compatibility:** 1.1 and 1.0 phones talk to each other: text, DMs and replies work both ways. Reactions, deletions, waves, timers, SOS and channels need 1.1 on both phones. Updating keeps your chats.

---

**Install:** download **`Murmur-v1.1.0.apk`** below and open it on your phone (allow "install unknown apps" if Android asks). `Murmur-v1.1.0-debug.apk` is the debug build: same app, slower animations. Both are signed with the same key, so newer versions install over older ones and keep your chats.
